blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal tabular learning combines tabular data with images and text, often in settings where labeled data are scarce. Tabular foundation models such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) offer a promising solution via in-context learning without task-specific training. However, modern image and text encoders produce embeddings with hundreds or thousands of dimensions, far exceeding the number of features encountered during PFN pretraining. Existing approaches bridge this gap using principal component analysis (PCA) to compress frozen embeddings. Surprisingly, we find that this PCA interface can underperform simple linear classifiers when labeled examples are scarce, even though PFNs are designed for small datasets. We identify the underlying failure mechanism: the PFN's per-column standardization removes the variances of the PCA scores. When the PCA keeps every direction of the labeled examples, the examples collapse into a regular simplex in which all pairwise distances are equal. To address this problem, we propose Rotated Frozen Embeddings (RoFE), a training-free method that rotates PCA scores before PFN inference. We theoretically show that rotation makes the column variances nearly equal, so that standardization approximately preserves the embedding geometry. Across image and text classification tasks, encoders, and tabular foundation models, RoFE improves low-data performance over the PCA interface and outperforms baselines that require task-specific training. The improvements also extend to regression.
blocks.zh: 多式联运表征学习将表征数据与图像和文本相结合,往往在标签数据稀缺的环境下进行. 表格基础模型,如以前安装的数据网络,通过不进行具体任务培训的内文学习,提供了一个有希望的解决办法。 然而,现代的图像和文本编码器产生嵌入式,具有数百或数千个维度,远远超过PFN预训过程中遇到的特性数量. 现有方法利用主要组件分析来压缩冷冻嵌入物来弥补这一差距。 令人惊讶的是,我们发现,这个PCA接口在标签上的例子很少时,可能无法很好地表现简单的线性分类器,尽管PFN是为小数据集设计的. 我们确定潜在的失败机制:PFN的每栏标准化消除了PCA分数的差异. 当五氯苯甲醚保持标签示例的每一个方向时,示例会崩溃成一个普通的简单x,其中所有双向距离是相等的. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用旋转冻嵌入法(ROFE),这是一种在PFN推论前旋转PCA分数的无训练方法. 我们理论上表明,旋转使列差异几乎相等,因此标准化大约可以保留嵌入几何. 在整个图像和文本分类任务、编码器和表格基础模型中,RoFE在PCA接口上改进了低数据性能,并超越了需要具体任务培训的基线。 改进范围还包括倒退。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal tabular learning aims to predict outcomes by jointly analyzing structured tabular features and unstructured data, such as images and text ( Arazi et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . Applications span healthcare and e-commerce, where patient records may be combined with medical images ( Pacheco et al., 2020 ) , or product attributes with text descriptions ( Shi et al., 2021 ) . A key challenge is effectively integrating these heterogeneous sources of information when labeled data are scarce, which is a common practical constraint in domains such as healthcare ( Jaeger et al., 2014 ; Marcus et al., 2010 ) .
blocks.zh: 多式联运表式学习旨在通过联合分析结构化表式特征和非结构化数据,如图像和文本(Arazi等人,2026年;Kim等人,2026年)来预测结果。 应用跨越保健和电子商务,其中病人记录可以与医疗图像结合(Pacheco等人,2020年),或带有文字描述的产品属性(Shi等人,2021年)。 一项关键挑战是,在贴上标签的数据稀缺时,有效整合这些不同的信息来源,这是保健等领域常见的实际制约因素(Jaeger等人,2014年;Marcus等人,2010年)。

blocks.en: Existing methods typically use pretrained encoders to transform images and text into high-dimensional embeddings, which are then combined with tabular features through early or late fusion ( Huang et al., 2020 ; Tang et al., 2024 ) . These methods generally require training a prediction head or fusion model on each task, which can be challenging with limited labels. Recently, prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), such as TabPFN and TabICL, have emerged as a promising alternative ( Müller et al., 2022 ; Hollmann et al., 2023 ; Hollmann et al., 2025 ; Qu et al., 2025 ) . PFNs are Transformers pretrained on synthetic prediction tasks that predict labels from a set of labeled examples provided as context, without task-specific training. Their strong performance on small tabular datasets ( Erickson et al., 2025 ) has motivated growing interest in extending them to multimodal learning. Recent methods include CoMET ( Bergström et al., 2026 ) , which combines frozen image and text embeddings with PFNs without additional training, and MultiModalPFN ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , which learns modality projections and fine-tunes the PFN for each dataset.
blocks.zh: 现有方法一般使用预先训练的编码器将图像和文字转化为高维嵌入,然后通过早期或晚聚变与表征特征结合(黄等人,2020年;唐等人,2024年). 这些方法一般都要求就每项任务培训一个预测头或聚变模型,而使用有限的标签可能具有挑战性. 最近,前置数据网络(PFNs),如TabPFN和TabICL,已成为一种有希望的替代办法(Müller等人,2022年;Holmann等人,2023年;Holmann等人,2025年;Qu等人,2025年)。 PFNs是预先接受过合成预测任务训练的变形器,从一组标注的例子中预测标签,作为上下文提供,没有针对特定任务的训练. 它们在小型表格数据集(Erickson等人,2025年)上的强效表现促使人们越来越有兴趣将这些数据集扩展到多式联运。 近期的方法包括CoMET(Bergström等人,2026年),将冷冻图像和文本嵌入与PFN结合而无需额外训练,以及MultiModalPFN(Kim等人,2026年),该方法学习模式预测,并对每个数据集的PFN进行微调.

blocks.en: A key challenge in applying PFNs to multimodal learning is the dimensionality mismatch between pretrained embeddings and tabular data: popular image encoders, such as DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) and SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) , produce 768- and 1,152-dimensional embeddings, whereas TabICLv2 was pretrained on tables with at most 100 features ( Qu et al., 2026 ) . To bridge this gap, CoMET ( Bergström et al., 2026 ) uses principal component analysis (PCA) to reduce the dimensionality of frozen embeddings before concatenating them with tabular features and passing them to a PFN. We refer to this approach as the PCA interface . While this provides a simple, training-free solution, we observe that it performs surprisingly poorly when labeled examples are scarce, which is precisely the setting where PFNs are expected to excel ( Table 1 ). This unexpected result raises a fundamental question: Why does a PFN fall behind a simple linear classifier on frozen embeddings in low-data settings, and can this limitation be overcome without additional training ?
blocks.zh: 将PFNs应用到多式联运学习中的一个关键挑战是预先训练的嵌入和表格数据之间的维度不匹配:流行的图像编码器,如DINov3(Siméoni等人,2026年)和SigLIP(Zhai等人,2023年),生成768-和1,152维嵌入,而TabICLv2则在最多100个特性的表格上预先训练(Qu等人,2026年)。 为了弥补这一差距,CoMET(Bergström等人,2026年)使用主要组件分析(PCA)来降低冷冻嵌入物的维度,然后将冷冻嵌入物用表格形式装饰,并传递给PFN. 我们将此方法称为常设仲裁法院接口。 虽然这提供了一个简单、无培训的解决办法,但我们看到,在贴上标签的事例很少的情况下,它的表现出人意料地差,这正是方案框架预期会取得优异成绩的场合(表1)。 这一意外结果提出了一个根本问题: 为什么一个PFN在低数据环境中的冷冻嵌入上会落后于一个简单的线性分类器,而不经过更多的培训,这种限制是可以克服的?

blocks.en: We identify a previously overlooked interaction between PCA and the per-column standardization used by PFNs. PCA produces components with different variances, reflecting the variance spectrum of the embeddings. However, PFNs standardize each component on its own. This removes the differences in variance and scales up the directions of low variance. Surprisingly, when PCA retains all n − 1 n-1 directions from n n labeled examples, this operation causes all labeled examples to become equally distant from one another, regardless of their classes ( Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们查明了先前被忽视的五氯苯甲醚与全氟化学品网络使用的每栏标准化之间的相互作用。 五氯苯甲醚产生的组件有不同的差异,反映了嵌入物的不同频谱。 然而,国家政策网将每个组成部分单独标准化。 这将消除差异差异,并将低差异的方向上调。 令人惊讶的是,当五氯苯甲醚从 n 标签的示例中保留所有 n − 1 n 1 个方向时,这一操作会导致所有标签的示例彼此同样远离,而不论其类别(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: To address this problem, we propose Ro tated F rozen E mbeddings ( RoFE ), a simple, training-free transformation that randomly rotates the PCA scores before they enter the PFN ( Figure 1 ). The rotation keeps the distances between rows and makes the column variances nearly equal. The standardization then scales every column by nearly the same factor and approximately preserves the embedding geometry ( Proposition 4.1 ). Without the rotation, replacing the standardization with one global scale keeps the component variances but gains little ( Table 3 ). The rotation also moves these variances into the correlations between columns, which the PFN reads. RoFE requires no additional training or modifications to the pretrained encoders, PFNs, or original tabular features.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们提议采用Ro teed F rozen E mbeddings(RoFE),这是一种简单,无训练的转换,在进入PFN前随机旋转PCA分数(图1). 旋转保持各行之间的距离,使列差异几乎相等。 然后,标准化按几乎相同的系数对每一列进行衡量,大约保留嵌入几何学(提议4.1)。 如果不轮换,以一个全球比额表取代标准化,则构成部分差异保持不变,但收益甚微(表3)。 旋转还将这些差异移动到列之间的关联中,PFN读取这些差异. RoFE不需要对预训编码器,PFN或原始表格功能进行额外的培训或修改.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We identify and mathematically characterize a failure mode of PCA-based multimodal learning with PFNs, showing how per-column standardization can destroy embedding geometry in low-data settings ( Propositions 3.1 and 3.2 ). • We introduce RoFE and theoretically demonstrate how random rotations redistribute variance across components to preserve geometric relationships through standardization ( Propositions 4.1 , 4.2 and 4.3 ). • Experiments on 24 image and 20 text classification tasks, with four encoders and four PFNs, show that RoFE consistently improves the PCA interface in low-data settings. It also outperforms baselines that require task-specific training. The gain carries over to regression tasks.

Learners that follow the coordinate axes can need far fewer samples than rotation-invariant ones when few columns
matter ( Ng, 2004 ) , which favors trees on tables of measured variables ( Grinsztajn et al., 2022 ) . Rotation
Forest ( Rodríguez et al., 2006 ) and random rotation ensembles ( Blaser and Fryzlewicz, 2016 ) rotate the features before
training decision trees and average over rotations, and random-projection ensembles ( Cannings and Samworth, 2017 ) combine
classifiers trained on random projections. RoFE also averages over random rotations, but its learner is a
pretrained PFN that is never trained on the task, and the rotation spreads the variance of the principal component scores almost evenly over the columns before the PFN standardizes each column.

For each fold, we sample 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, and 500 labeled examples per class, with three independent draws per sample size. We also evaluate using the full labeled training pool. Performance is measured by AUROC for binary classification and macro-averaged one-versus-rest AUROC for multiclass tasks. Results are averaged across draws and folds within each task, then across tasks. We report 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for performance differences across tasks and the number of tasks on which RoFE outperforms CoMET.

blocks.en: We extract image embeddings using DINOv3 ViT-B/16 (class token) ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) and SigLIP so400m (pooled output) ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) . For text, we concatenate fields in “name: value” format and extract mean-pooled embeddings using ELECTRA-base ( Clark et al., 2020 ) and E5-base-v2 ( Wang et al., 2022 ) . The primary PFN is TabICLv2 ( Qu et al., 2026 ) with its default eight-member ensemble. We also evaluate TabPFN v2 ( Hollmann et al., 2025 ) , TabPFN 2.5 ( Grinsztajn et al., 2025 ) , and TabPFN 3.5 ( Jäger et al., 2026 ) ( Appendix C ).

blocks.en: Our primary baseline is CoMET’s PCA interface, which retains min ⁡ ( n − 1,256 ) \min(n-1,256) principal components fitted on the labeled examples and uses the same PFN as RoFE. We re-implement this interface following CoMET ( Bergström et al., 2026 ) ( Appendix C ). We also compare against a linear probe using logistic regression on standardized embeddings, with one-hot-encoded tabular features and regularization selected by cross-validation on the labeled examples. Task-specific trained baselines include MultiModalPFN ( Kim et al., 2026 ) and CatBoost ( Prokhorenkova et al., 2018 ) ( Section D.5 ). Additional baselines and benchmarks are provided in Appendix D .

blocks.en: Table 1 (left half) compares RoFE with CoMET and a linear probe. Across 10–100 labeled examples per class, RoFE consistently outperforms CoMET with both image encoders, using either image embeddings alone or combined with tabular features. With DINOv3 image embeddings alone and 10 labels per class, RoFE outperforms CoMET on 23 of 24 tasks. The improvements diminish as the number of labeled examples increases ( Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 表1(左半部分)将RoFE与CoMET和一个线性探测器进行比较. 在每类标注的10-100个实例中,RoFE始终优于具有两种图像编码器的CoMET,要么单独使用图像嵌入,要么与表格特征相结合。 通过DINov3图像单独嵌入和每类10个标签,RoFE在24项任务中的23项超越了CoMET. 随着标注实例数量的增加,这些改进有所减少(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: RoFE also consistently outperforms CoMET across 10–100 labels per class with both text encoders, using text embeddings alone or combined with tabular features ( Table 1 , right half). These results demonstrate that the benefits extend across image and text modalities and different pretrained encoders ( Section D.1 ).
blocks.zh: RoFE还一贯超越每类10-100个标签的CoMET,两个文本编码器都使用文本嵌入或与表格特征结合(表1,右半). 这些结果表明,这些好处涉及图像和文本模式以及不同的事先训练过的编码器(D.1节)。

blocks.en: Table 2 evaluates RoFE with different PFNs. RoFE improves TabPFN v2, TabPFN 2.5, and TabPFN 3.5 across 10–100 labels per class, with all encoders and both embedding-only and multimodal inputs ( Table 7 ). This suggests that the improvement is not specific to TabICLv2.
blocks.zh: 表2用不同的PFN评价RoFE. RoFE改进了TabPFN v2, TabPFN 2.5,和TabPFN 3.5的每类10-100个标签,所有编码器以及只嵌入式和多式联运输入(表7)。 这表明这种改进并非专门针对TabICLv2。

blocks.en: Among the evaluated prediction heads, the linear probe is the strongest head ( Section D.4 ). With image embeddings alone and 10 labels per class, CoMET underperforms the linear probe by 2.1 AUROC points, whereas RoFE achieves comparable performance. RoFE outperforms the linear probe from 25 labels per class with image-only inputs and across all label budgets when tabular features are included. Despite requiring no task-specific training, RoFE also outperforms MultiModalPFN and CatBoost ( Section D.5 ).
blocks.zh: 在评估的预测头中,线性探测头是最强的(D.4节). 单凭图像嵌入和每类10个标签,CoMET以2.1 AUROC点来压低线性探测器的性能,而RoFE则能实现可比较的性能. RoFE在包含表格特性时,从每类有25个只使用图像输入的标签和所有标签预算的线性探测器上超越。 尽管不需要针对具体任务的培训,RoFE的成绩也超过了MultiModalPFN和CatBoost(D.5节)。

blocks.en: We compare RoFE with directly feeding raw embeddings into the PFN without PCA ( Figure 1 ). With DINOv3, RoFE outperforms this baseline across 10–100 labels per class, with and without tabular features ( Section D.11 ). This demonstrates that PCA remains beneficial when combined with the proposed rotation.
blocks.zh: 我们比较RoFE和直接将原始嵌入物注入没有五氯苯甲醚的PFN(图1)。 随着DINOv3的出现,RoFE在每类10-100个标签上都超过了这一基准,有和没有表格特征(D.11节)。 这表明,与拟议的轮换相结合,常设仲裁法院仍然是有益的。

blocks.en: 5.2 Mechanism
blocks.zh: 5.2 机制

blocks.en: Figure 4 compares different transformations of the same PCA scores. Averaging multiple PFN seeds without rotation provides little improvement. Rotating only within the strong or the weak directions also yields limited gains, particularly at 10 labels per class, consistent with Proposition 4.3 . In contrast, a dense Hadamard transform performs comparably to random rotation, with further gains from averaging four rotations. Sparse Givens rotations, despite equalizing column variances, perform worse than dense rotations ( Appendix B ). Furthermore, replacing the PCA span with a random orthonormal basis reduces performance ( Section D.11 ). These results suggest that RoFE benefits from densely mixing principal directions while preserving the span of the labeled embeddings ( Section D.8 ).
blocks.zh: 图4比较了相同PCA分数的不同变化. 不旋转地显示多种PFN种子,没有什么改进。 只在强项或弱项方向内轮换也产生有限的收益,特别是每类10个标签,符合建议4.3。 与此相反,密集的哈达马德变换可比较地进行随机旋转,从平均四次旋转得到进一步的收益。 Sparse Gives 旋转,尽管列位差异相等,但表现不如密集旋转(附录B)。 此外,用随机的正反基取代常设仲裁法院的跨度会降低绩效(D.11节)。 这些结果表明,RoFE在保持标注嵌入的长度的同时,从密集混合的主要方向中获益(D.8节)。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Effect of different changes of basis. AUROC gains over CoMET on 24 image classification tasks using image embeddings alone. Error bars indicate 95% confidence intervals across tasks. RoFE and the no-rotation baseline average four runs; all other methods use a single transformation.

blocks.en: Table 3 compares per-column standardization with global scaling, which preserves the original PCA variance spectrum. Without rotation, global scaling changes performance by less than one AUROC point on image tasks and up to about one point on text tasks, suggesting that TabICL makes limited use of variance information in individual column scales. Even under identical global scaling (hence identical distances), rotated scores outperform unrotated PCA scores by +1.5 to +2.2 AUROC points on image-only tasks. These findings suggest that rotation improves how the variance spectrum is represented, beyond merely preventing its removal by standardization.
blocks.zh: 表3比较了每栏标准化与全球尺度,这保持了原有的PCA差异谱. 不旋转,全局缩放在图像任务上以小于一个AUROC点修改性能,在文本任务上以小于一个点为限,说明TabICL在单个列尺度上对差异信息的使用有限. 即使在相同的全局缩放(因此距离相同)下,旋转的得分也比未旋转的PCA得分高出+1.5到+2.2 AUROC在图像只任务上的得分. 这些调查结果表明,轮调不仅防止通过标准化消除差异,而且改善了差异谱的表示方式。

Otherwise, a single global scaling factor normalizes the mean column variance of the labeled examples to one.

blocks.en: Because PCA does not require labels, it can be fitted on additional unlabeled examples. Fitting PCA on the full training pool yields comparable performance to RoFE when the scores are rotated, but without rotation it underperforms by 1.6 to 2.7 AUROC points on image-only tasks. Similarly, fitting PCA on 100,000 ImageNet ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) embeddings does not improve over RoFE ( Section D.10 ). Thus, increasing the data used to fit PCA does not eliminate the benefit of rotation.
blocks.zh: 由于五氯苯甲醚不需要标签,因此可以将其安装在附加的无标签示例上。 在完全训练池上搭配PCA,在分数旋转时会产生与ROFE相当的性能,但是不旋转它表现不佳,在仅图像任务上只得到1.6到2.7 AUROC的分数. 同样,在100 000 ImageNet上安装五氯苯甲醚(Russakovsky等人,2015年)嵌入比RoFE没有改进(D.10节)。 因此,增加用于适合五氯苯甲醚的数据并不能消除轮换的好处。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 5 , RoFE achieves its largest gains when n ≤ 257 n\leq 257 , where PCA retains all n − 1 n-1 directions and the labeled examples undergo geometric collapse. The gains diminish as n n increases and approach zero for n > 1000 n>1000 , where PCA retains 256 directions. Within the same task, settings that retain all n − 1 n-1 directions show an additional +2.2-point improvement over those with truncated PCA representations. Similar trends are observed on text tasks.
blocks.zh: 如图5所示,RoFE在257 n\leq 257 时取得了最大的收益,其中五氯苯甲醚保留了所有n− 1 n-1方向,标注的例子经过几何崩溃。 增益随着nn的增加而减少,在n > 1000n>1000中接近0,其中五氯苯甲醚保留了256个方向。 在同一任务范围内,保留所有n - 1 n - 1方向的设置显示,与具有短路的五氯苯甲醚代表物的设置相比,还有+2.2分的改进。 在文本任务方面也观察到类似的趋势。

blocks.en: Reducing the number of components provides another way to mitigate the PCA interface’s limitations by discarding low-variance directions. This improves CoMET from 25 labels per class onward. RoFE still outperforms CoMET with its best PCA dimensionality on image-only tasks, while the two perform comparably when tabular features are included. Rotation also improves performance with fewer PCA components, although the gains are smaller ( Section D.9 ).
blocks.zh: 减少组件数量为降低PCA接口的局限性提供了另一种途径,即放弃低变异方向. 这从每类的25个标签改进了CoMET. RoFE仍然优于CoMET,在仅用于图像的任务上具有最佳的PCA维度,而两者在包含表格特性时表现得相当. 轮调还使五氯苯甲醚组件较少,从而改善了性能,尽管收益较小(D.9节)。

In this experiment, we retain all classes in Hearthstone (11), wine reviews (30), and Spotify genres (114). With image or text embeddings alone, RoFE outperforms CoMET on all three tasks at 10 and 25 labels per class, with gains of up to 8.3 AUROC points. At 100 or more labels per class, the methods perform within one point of each other ( Section D.14 ).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitation
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en:
In this study, we investigate why PFNs can underperform simple linear classifiers on frozen embeddings when labeled data are scarce. We show that per-column standardization removes the variances of the principal component scores and collapses labeled examples into a regular simplex when all n − 1 n-1 principal directions are retained. To address this issue, we propose RoFE, which rotates the principal component scores at random before they reach the PFN. The
rotation moves the spectrum into the column correlations that the PFN reads and makes the standardization
divide every column by nearly the same factor. Across image and text classification tasks, four encoders and four PFNs,
RoFE consistently improves on the PCA interface when labeled rows are few. Without any training, it also outperforms baselines that require task-specific training, and the
gain carries over to regression tasks.
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,我们调查为什么PFNs在贴有标签的数据稀缺的情况下,在冷冻嵌入物上不能很好地进行简单的线性分类. 我们显示,每栏标准化可以消除主元件分数的差异,并在保留所有n−1n-1主方向时,将标注的示例折叠成正简x. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议ROFE,在达到PFN之前,它随机旋转主要成分分数. 那个
旋转将频谱移动到PFN读取的列内关联,使标准化
每列除以几乎相同的因数。 整个图像和文本分类任务,四个编码器和四个PFN,
RoFE在标注的行数很少时,PAC接口不断改进. 如果没有任何培训,它的业绩也超过了需要具体任务培训的基线,而且
收益转到回归任务。

blocks.en: This work has several limitations. First, RoFE’s gain is largest with limited labeled data and diminishes as the dataset grows. Second, averaging predictions over multiple rotations increases inference cost. Finally, our evaluation focuses on image and text embeddings. Future work should evaluate RoFE on additional modalities.
blocks.zh: 这项工作有几个局限性。 首先,RoFE的收益最大,因为贴有有限标签的数据,随着数据集的增长而减少。 第二,对多次轮换的平均预测会增加推论成本。 最后,我们评价的重点是图像和文字嵌入。 今后的工作应评估欧洲经济共同体关于其他模式的工作。

blocks.en:
A product of Givens rotations, each mixing two columns, can also make all column variances equal. Such a product exists
by the Schur–Horn theorem [ Horn, 1954 ] , and we build it column pair by column pair ( Section D.8 ). It tests whether equal
variances alone carry the gain. With TabICL, Givens rotations stay within half a point of AUROC of random rotations at
ten labels per class and underperform them as the labels grow, and with TabPFN they underperform from ten labels per
class ( Table 16 ). RoFE therefore uses dense rotations. One possible reason is that TabICL first embeds each
column on its own [ Qu et al., 2025 ] . A sparse mix leaves some columns with mostly signal and others with mostly
noise at the same variance, while a dense mix gives every column about the same share of each principal direction
( Figure 7 ).

Hearthstone (11 classes), Spotify genres (114) and wine reviews (30) keep ten classes per fold, drawn uniformly at
random from the classes of the labeled pool with a fixed seed per task and fold. In every task, a class with fewer rows
in the labeled pool than the number drawn enters with all of its rows.

TabICLv2 runs with its default eight ensemble members.
TabPFN 2.5 and TabPFN 3.5 run with the defaults of the tabpfn package, eight members, under their non-commercial licenses, and TabPFN v2 runs with four members. The feature “rotation” of
the TabPFN implementation shifts the column order cyclically and does not mix the columns.

blocks.en:

and RoFE use the same PFN, the same members and the same random state. RoFE’s rotations are drawn from fixed seeds. Every run uses a single NVIDIA A100 or L40S GPU, and the linear probe and the other
heads run on CPUs.

气象卫星

头靠CPU运行.

blocks.en:
The linear probe standardizes the embedding on the labeled rows and fits a logistic regression
with an L 2 L_{2} penalty (scikit-learn, at most 2000 iterations), its inverse strength chosen among 0.01, 0.1, 1 and 10 by
stratified three-fold cross-validation of the log-loss on the labeled rows. Missing table values are imputed, numbers by their
median and categories as a category of their own. Numbers are then standardized and categories one-hot encoded, with
unseen categories ignored.

线性探测器将嵌入标记的行标准化并符合逻辑回归
其反向强度从0.01、0.1、1和10中选择

中位数和类别作为自己的类别。 数字随后标准化,分类为一热编码,
忽略了隐形分类 。

blocks.en:
CoMET releases no code for its pipeline, so we implement it from the description in its Sections 4 and 6.1. It takes
the class token of DINOv3 or the mean-pooled ELECTRA embedding and fits a PCA on the labeled rows with min ⁡ ( n − 1,256 ) \min(n-1,256) components, without whitening. TabICLv2 then runs on the scores and the table columns. The authors’
research repository, which holds their PAL (Pseudo Attention Labels) pooling, uses the same settings.

blocks.en:
Three choices are ours and are shared with
RoFE, so that the two differ only in the interface. The text embedding averages over all tokens, the table columns reach the PFN as they are, without a table vectorizer, and TabICLv2 runs with its default eight members.
TabICLv2 then turns each categorical column into integer codes learned on the labeled rows, with one extra code for
missing and unseen values, and fills missing numbers with their mean on the labeled rows. TabPFN receives integer
codes learned on the fold’s pool, with the categorical columns marked as such, and leaves out columns that have no value
on the labeled rows.

roFE,因此两者只在界面上有所不同. 文本嵌入在所有符号上的平均值,表格列按原样到达PFN,没有表格矢量器,TabICLv2运行时有默认的8个成员.

缺少和未见的值,并用标签行上的平均值填充缺失数字。 TabPFN 得到整数
在折叠池中学习到的代码, 并标出绝对的列, 并留下没有值的列
在标签的行。

blocks.en:
MultiModalPFN [ Kim et al., 2026 ] fine-tunes TabPFN v2 on the labeled rows together with learned projectors
for the image embedding. We run the authors’ code and model with DINOv3 on the 24 image tasks (SigLIP’s 1152

columns. CatBoost [ Prokhorenkova et al., 2018 ] follows MulTaBench’s
baseline [ Arazi et al., 2026 ] : 2000 iterations with early stopping on 10% of the labeled rows, the table’s

standardized first. With few labels the PCA keeps min ⁡ ( 30 , n train − 1 ) \min(30,n_{\text{train}}-1) components and the validation part holds

TabSTAR [ Arazi et al., 2025 ] encode the text cells inside a model of their own and lie outside the interface
studied here.
